name: NATGATE
recent: NationGate 近期公布 2026 财年第二季业绩，营收同比下滑但净利环比大幅回升；公司宣布每股 0.25 仙中期股息，并完成库存股变动。同期出现董事及大股东股权变动申报，以及拟以 RM38mil 向 WTK 收购槟城工业物业的新闻。
notable: 宣布 2026 财年每股 0.25 仙中期单层股息。
新闻报导公司拟以 RM38mil 向 WTK 收购槟城工业物业。
公司被纳入 MSCI Malaysia Small Cap Index。
risks: 董事及大股东在近期多次申报股权变动，包括股份授予归属及场外交易。
公司发布库存股变动公告，涉及已回购股份的处置。
earnings: 2026 财年第二季营收为 MYR 1,768.93 million，环比增长 2.8%，但同比下滑 32.1%；净利为 MYR 10.90 million，环比大增 2,029.7%，同比减少 79.1%，净利率为 0.6%。

recent_en: NationGate recently announced its 2Q FY2026 results, with revenue declining year-on-year but net profit rebounding sharply quarter-on-quarter. The company declared an interim dividend of 0.25 sen per share and completed changes in treasury shares. During the same period, there were director and substantial shareholder interest disclosures, and news of a proposed RM38mil acquisition of Penang industrial properties from WTK.
notable_en: Declared an interim single-tier dividend of 0.25 sen per share for FY2026.
News reported a proposed acquisition of Penang industrial properties from WTK for RM38mil.
The company was added to the MSCI Malaysia Small Cap Index.
risks_en: Directors and substantial shareholders made multiple disclosures of changes in interest recently, including vesting of share grants and off-market transactions.
The company announced changes in treasury shares, involving the disposal of repurchased shares.
earnings_en: 2Q FY2026 revenue was MYR 1,768.93 million, up 2.8% qoq but down 32.1% yoy; net profit was MYR 10.90 million, up 2,029.7% qoq but down 79.1% yoy, with a net margin of 0.6%.
